## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `make lint` (or `bash -n` on any shell script I touched) and it passes.
- [ ] I only edited files on my branch / did not force-push shared history.
- [ ] If I added a new or changed shell script, it has a `set -euo pipefail` shebang and is executable.
- [ ] If I changed docs, internal links still resolve.
- [ ] I did **not** commit secrets, tokens, personal logs, hostnames or IP addresses.
- [ ] I did **not** add another `*.bak`/backup file next to `/etc/grub.d/*` scripts (GRUB executes them).
